text:
I understand completely. The hiking boots return is properly documented in your account, and the $245.99 refund is set to go to your PayPal account once the return is processed.

If you don't see that refund within 7 business days after returning the boots, please call back and we'll get it resolved for you.

Have a good day, Liam!
zh:
我完全理解。徒步靴退货已经在您的账户中正确记录，$245.99 退款将在退货处理后发送到您的 PayPal 账户。

如果在退回徒步靴后 7 个工作日内未看到该退款，请回电，我们会为您解决。

祝您有美好的一天，Liam！
